cohort: Nulliparous women aged 35 years and older with a singleton and cephalic presentation who delivered at term
finding: In nulliparous women aged 35 years and older, nonmedically indicated induction of labor at 37 to 39 weeks' gestation was associated with decreased odds of cesarean delivery, and at 40 weeks' gestation with decreased odds of NICU admission.
mod_finding: At 40 weeks' gestation, nonmedically indicated induction of labor was associated with an increased odds of operative vaginal delivery.
